global_assertions.check: 所有 occurrence.kind ∈ {first, repeat_unresolved, repeat_after_fix, rollback_regress}；无 reopen_recurrence / fix_not_live / deployment_drift / similar_but_distinct / related_case

所有 bug_links.role ∈ {primary_fix, related_fix, background, status_evidence, report}；旧词（related/root_cause/failed_delivery/second_fix/origin）不得作 role
描述标签（fix_not_live / fix_not_effective / deployment_drift / mr_ref_unverified / context_only）只出现在 reason/basis/review.reason/报告，不写入枚举字段
每个案例的 expected_counts 十项指标齐全；null/未知已注明原因，未用 0 冒充未知
recurrence_events 与 recurrence_by_subtype 同时给出，且总数 == 两子类型之和
